chunks: Marked by your Lord for those who waste their substance.

key_terms.لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ: For those who waste or exceed limits (in spending/resources)
key_terms.مُسَوَّمَةً: Marked or branded with a sign

ai.seo_question: Who are the 'musrifin' that God marks for wasting their wealth?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, 'al-musrifin' refers not only to general wastefulness but specifically to those who exceed divine boundaries in spending, often linked to the concept of *israf* in economic ethics. This 'branding' signifies a permanent spiritual mark of excess that distinguishes them in the Hereafter, reinforcing the Prophetic tradition that moderation is a hallmark of the faithful.
